tara_onboard: Quick heads-up: while running the new onboarding flow we saw intermittent 'holes' in batched embeddings/rerank responses from the Node sampleapp. Single curl calls are fine; the batcher helper seems implicated.

eli_sdk: Can you paste a tiny repro and the raw response? Also which SDK version?

tara_onboard: Node SDK v1.0.2, sampleapp default batcher. Repro payload (two inputs):
```json
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{ "model": "open-vec-3", "inputs": ["alpha","beta"] }
```
Observed response sometimes: `{ "results": [ {"embedding": [0.01,...] }, null ] }` or `{ "results": [ null, {"embedding": [...]} ] }`. No errors.

frank_infra: This sounds like the token refresh + retry partial replay bug we've been tracking. If the auth layer refreshes mid-request the retry wrapper can resend only part of the batch; server merges fragments but client zipper uses positional indexing and ends up with nulls for missing slots.

eli_sdk: Repro here when forcing expiry. Short-term fix I pushed locally: add a stable client-side id to each input (client_id: nanoid()) and have the zipper reconstruct results by id instead of array index. Stops holes in my smoke runs.

mei_docs: Good. Can we also add a sanity check in the SDK: if any returned entry is null/empty, automatically retry the entire batch once and log a clear message pointing to auth/retry as likely cause? That helps customers who don't upgrade right away.

frank_infra: Agreed. Longer-term we'll also make auth refresh single-flight (block other requests until refresh done) and change retry wrapper to replay whole batches. Filing INFRA-920.

eli_sdk: One extra wrinkle: the embeddings endpoint uses the field name "embedding" while rerank uses "vector" in some codepaths. That led to a few parity bugs in the zipper. I'm normalizing the SDK to accept both and map to an internal "vec" key.

tara_onboard: Nice. After adding client_id remap + the retry-on-null guard, my local runs (5k with forced expiry) show no holes.

ci-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sdk-node/pulls/1352 - "batcher: client_id remap, retry-on-null, normalize embedding/vector". Tests queued.

mei_docs: I'll add a short troubleshooting note to onboarding docs: "If you see null/empty vectors from batched requests, enable BATCHER_MAP_BY_CLIENT_ID and upgrade SDKs; this is usually caused by token refresh/retry races." Filing DOCS-541.

tara_onboard: Thanks team. Leaving follow-ups on the PR and INFRA ticket. Ping me if any flake remains. :thumbsup:
